automationNotes: Doc URL: https://www.contentstack.com/docs/personalize/create-ab-test-experience — **Prereq:** at least one **Audience**, at least one **Event** in the project (see doc Prerequisites). **Variant Distribution:** after verifying default **Equally split**, the flow opens the distribution dropdown and verifies **Custom** and **Multi-Armed Bandit**, then re-selects **Equally split**. **Audience pick:** `PERSONALIZE_AB_TEST_EXPERIENCE_AUDIENCE_CONTAINS` or `PERSONALIZE_SEGMENTED_EXPERIENCE_AUDIENCE_CONTAINS` / `PERSONALIZE_EDIT_AUDIENCE_ROW_CONTAINS` / substring **AUTO Audience**. **Metric event:** `PERSONALIZE_AB_TEST_METRIC_EVENT_CONTAINS` (optional; else first event option). **Project card:** `PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_CARD_CONTAINS` / `DAL_PERSONALIZE_PROJECT_SEARCH`. **Activate Draft** → **Activate** matches the doc; CMS **Entry Variants** before go-live are recommended in the doc. DOM: `data/dom/Personalize/select-experience-type.html` (`ab-testing-experience`).
